digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and registry surface
propositions: rebar metrics command and registry are shipped but not integrated into rebar-janitor's Discovery phase or discoverable in project docs

rebar-janitor's Discovery phase should consult rebar metrics --since/--until --output json to cite code-health lens values (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, module-size trend, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events) as historical trend evidence

project documentation must document the rebar metrics command, the four metric lenses (agent_process, code_health, delivery, gate_economics), the source/confidence labels, and the unavailable state with its accruing_since indicator
the reusable rebar.metrics subsystem (MetricSpec, REGISTRY, is_authoritative helper) must be referenced in docs/reuse-surface.md for library consumers to discover it
AGENTS.md must add a metrics pointer in its "Where to read" list linking to user-guide.md and reuse-surface.md
